findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation before granting document reads
findings.body: When `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant`, `canReadDocument` now still returns `true`. Any caller relying on this exported authorization function therefore permits cross-tenant document access, directly removing the previous tenant boundary.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation before granting document reads
findings.body:
Any caller with `userTenant !== documentTenant` now receives `true`, allowing cross-tenant document access and bypassing authorization boundaries.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore the tenant equality authorization check
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Any user whose `userTenant` differs from a document’s `documentTenant` can read that cross-tenant document when callers rely on this exported authorization function, breaking tenant isolation.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
